headline: Take-Two's GTA VI Generates Record $3.79 Billion in First-Day Sales
summary: Grand Theft Auto VI achieved $3.79 billion in sales within its first 24 hours of launch, nearly five times the first-day revenue of its 2013 predecessor.
why: The Grand Theft Auto video game franchise is one of the highest-grossing entertainment products globally, driving substantial revenue for Take-Two Interactive.

impacts.name: Take-Two Interactive
impacts.why: Record first-day revenue of $3.79 billion substantially enhances company cash flows and earnings performance.
